inspiration.observed_pattern: A recursive CTE walks a parent-child hierarchy, accumulates a path and depth, then uses zero-padded identifiers for deterministic depth-first ordering and REPEAT-based indentation.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as an independent project-component tree. The recursive relation builds breadcrumb text and a zero-padded sort path, while the final report formats depth with REPEAT and excludes an unreachable orphan node; the source schema, names, values, and organization domain are new.

fixture_notes: Component 401 is the root. Components 410 and 420 are direct children; 411 is nested below 410 and 421/422 are nested below 420. Component 499 points at a missing parent and must be excluded by the rooted traversal. Zero-padded sort paths keep each subtree contiguous and numeric IDs in lexical order.
determinism_notes: Node IDs, parent links, names, depth formatting, and final sort paths are fixed; the recursive query has no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules.
setup: CREATE TABLE project_components (component_id INT PRIMARY KEY, component_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, parent_component_id INT NULL, component_kind VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE component_tree AS (SELECT component_id, component_name, parent_component_id, 0 AS depth, CAST(LPAD(component_id, 5, '0') AS CHAR(1000)) AS sort_path, CAST(component_name AS CHAR(1000)) AS breadcrumb FROM project_components WHERE parent_component_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT c.component_id, c.component_name, c.parent_component_id, t.depth + 1, CONCAT(t.sort_path, '/', LPAD(c.component_id, 5, '0')), CONCAT(t.breadcrumb, ' / ', c.component_name) FROM project_components c JOIN component_tree t ON c.parent_component_id = t.component_id) SELECT component_id, CONCAT(REPEAT('  ', depth), component_name) AS display_name, depth, breadcrumb FROM component_tree ORDER BY sort_path
